notes: Mage-VL-Cowork.litertlm of litert-community/Mage-VL-Cowork: microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork (Apache-2.0; a 4B computer-use agent: a 24-layer vision encoder and a Qwen3-4B text decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1920 x 1088 screenshot per request and writes the agent's next action. Published 2026-11-05 (Hub main 38bf428b at the read). Measured 2026-11-04 in the run r10 (the published bytes).
quantization: text decoder (36 layers, Qwen3-4B) with INT4 weights (blockwise, 128 per block, OCTAV) and a 4,096-token KV cache, no activation type declared = FP16 on the GPU through an exact rotary-position path; INT8 embedding table; vision encoder and adapter with FP32 weights, FP32 activations declared for the GPU; one 1920 x 1088 screenshot per request (2,040 image tokens)

output_match = the line: a reply is right when its first tool call is a click whose point, converted to the screenshot's pixels, falls inside the target's box; per group the rate must reach the original model's rate in fp32 or bf16, whichever is lower, minus 5 points (the original in PyTorch on the Mac's GPU, MPS, transformers 4.57.3, greedy); and every reply's tool call parses as JSON, ends at <|im_end|> and has an Action: line after </think>; scores: desktop 55.0 % (bar 47.5), web 65.0 % (bar 57.5), mobile 55.0 % (bar 50.0), all 120 58.3 % against the original's 60.0 % in fp32 and 60.8 % in bf16; JSON 100.0 %, stop failures 0, form failures 0; mobile is 7.5 points under the original in fp32 and equal to it in bf16
against the original on all 120 (right only in the original / right only in this form, exact McNemar p): fp32 12 / 10 (p 0.83), bf16 11 / 8 (p 0.65)
